angu_barkeep.text: Grilled lobster, fish, peas and rice. We're out of fork. We never had any.
This bar's built from driftwood, shipwreck timbers and good intentions. The good intentions hold up best.

angu_musician.text: Anguilla's a reggae kind of place: Sunday afternoons on the sand, music loud, no hurry. We've a festival in March too, on the beach.
I'll play you a tune if you buy a drink. If you don't buy a drink I'll play it anyway, but slower.
